race.description: Irresistible Pools And Spas Provincial Mdn Hcp
race.comment: DWIGHT (5) goes fast and has been racing in great heart of late. Denied in a photo two back over this distance at Bathurst then was again brave in defeat over 1300m here last time. Sure to be in this for a long way. COLD GIN (7) has switched stables and is back from a five-month spell. Beaten just 1.4 lengths at Canterbury at the start of the last campaign. Recent Kembla trial winner who looks well and truly up for this. ARTFULL (11) is yet to fill a placing in five runs but his last two outings, both here over 1300m, have been sound. Doubt he can win but worth including in exotics. Market watch on SAUVITUDE (3) first up from a spell following a gelding op.
